cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(flutter LANGUAGES CXX)

# This value is used when generating builds using the Flutter tool.
set(FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ephemeral")

# Flutter configuration is provided through a script generated by the Flutter tool.
include(${FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR}/generated_config.cmake OPTIONAL)

# The plugin-related files are generated by the Flutter tool.
include(${FLUTTER_MANAGED_DIR}/generated_plugins.cmake OPTIONAL)

# === Flutter Library ===
set(FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ephemeral")

# Published to parent scope for runner
set(FLUTTER_TARGET_PLATFORM "windows-x64" PARENT_SCOPE)

add_library(flutter INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(flutter INTERFACE
  "${FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR}"
)
target_link_libraries(flutter INTERFACE
  "${FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR}/flutter_windows.dll.lib"
)

add_library(flutter_wrapper_plugin INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(flutter_wrapper_plugin INTERFACE
  "${FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR}/cpp_client_wrapper/include"
)
target_link_libraries(flutter_wrapper_plugin INTERFACE
  flutter
)

add_library(flutter_wrapper_app INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(flutter_wrapper_app INTERFACE
  "${FLUTTER_EPHEMERAL_DIR}/cpp_client_wrapper/include"
)
target_link_libraries(flutter_wrapper_app INTERFACE
  flutter
)

# === Standard Project Settings ===
function(APPLY_STANDARD_SETTINGS TARGET)
  target_compile_features(${TARGET} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE /W4 /WX /wd"4100")
  target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE /EHsc)
  target_compile_definitions(${TARGET} PRIVATE "_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0")
  target_compile_definitions(${TARGET} PRIVATE "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:_DEBUG>")
endfunction()
